text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—5:00 AM, waking up. For the martial 
Umamusume, Yaeno Muteki, mornings start 
early.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Master, Acting Master, and my family... 
Good morning. Yaeno Muteki shall dedicate 
herself with diligence today as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Bathed in the refreshing morning 
sunlight, she bows toward her family home. 
Her day begins with a gesture of respect.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is the "routine" for this 
place. ...Starting recording.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"'As part of today's coverage, I will be 
documenting a slice of my daily life.'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"First... I run the washing machine in the 
dorm washroom. That way, the laundry is 
done by the time I finish my morning 
routine."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"There is a system where the dorm staff 
does all our laundry in bulk, but... that 
feels far too convenient."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Always maintain a spirit of self-reliance 
and independence—that too is a teaching 
from my master. On days when I have time, 
I wash my clothes by hand with a 
washboard, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep-beep... sploosh sploosh...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"On days I wish to devote myself to 
running, I rely on the washing machine 
like this. Laundry duty, I leave it in 
your care! Osu!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Next up, pre-exercise nutritional 
supplementation."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"We will be making miso soup using miso 
balls. That being said, all you have to do 
is dissolve them in hot water."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*pour... clink clink*)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"My grandmother regularly sends this to me 
from the dojo... Drinking it in the 
morning has been a habit of mine for a 
long time."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for the food."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Hot...!? Whew... Delicious. I make sure 
to drink a cup every morning to replenish 
minerals and stay hydrated."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... whew. "The running route is 
basically always the same."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"You see, whenever I run here around this 
time... Ah, looks like she's here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"A newspaper delivery motorcycle always 
passes down this road at this hour, making 
it quite convenient to use as a racing 
opponent."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, one must pay attention to 
traffic safety when running, but—ha!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... he-heheh...! It seems my 
engine is in exceptionally good condition 
today...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, even though I am still in 
training, I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As a result... I dropped the voice 
recorder and ended up stepping on it, 
smashing it to pieces...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to convey my passion for 
running, even just a little, and got far 
too carried away... It is entirely due to 
my own immaturity."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A voice recorder was lent to Yaeno Muteki 
for a magazine feature. Apparently, it 
ended up broken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll handle the apology myself... She 
tried her hardest to handle the interview 
and slipped up, so how should I follow up 
and support her?
choice_data_list:
Let's give it everything we've got to make 
up for it!

Put all your spirit into writing it down 
on paper!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So you mean I should give it my all on the 
day of the upcoming interview, and state 
my humble opinion on routines once more... 
is that correct?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. You are right, there is no use 
crying over spilled milk... I must show my 
gratitude through my actions going 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that that is decided, let us 
deliberate further upon the current 
morning routine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Every action has a purpose... I must 
ensure I can give prompt and clear answers 
about them during the interview!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's determination is strong. 
I'm sure it'll make for a wonderful 
interview...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah... What a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Since it's going into a magazine article, 
it might actually save the trouble of 
transcribing it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I will compile a flawless 
document detailing every aspect of my 
daily life!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There is no page limit, so let us write as 
much as we can. Enough to make up for our 
blunder...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the creation of the perfect 
research dossier spanning hundreds of 
pages. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't until after finishing the 
documents that I realized I could've just 
recorded it with my smartphone instead of 
a voice recorder...
